purpose: Teach: 市政/不正確/手引き/ライフサイクル/移設/定率/不払い/ファクス

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市政の動向を分析しろ
lines.en: Analyze the city government's trends for us.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Direct eye contact. Each word placed with precision. No room for interpretation—a directive, not a request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。不正確な情報は社外に出しません
lines.en: Yes. We won't release any inaccurate information outside the company.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Firm but not defensive. Hands-on posture—demonstrating competence through calm certainty, not elaboration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新人の手引き書を整備しろ
lines.en: Prepare an onboarding manual for new hires.
lines.style: Sharp, controlled delivery. Slight emphasis on the verb. No softening—this is a task assignment. Brief pause before moving on.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品のライフサイクルを見直します
lines.en: Yes. We'll review the product lifecycle management process.
lines.style: Measured response. Takes the weight of the task seriously. Voice steady and methodical, as if already mentally organizing the work ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本社の移設計画を進めろ
lines.en: Move forward with the headquarters relocation plan.
lines.style: Terse, decisive. Slight lean forward. The tone of someone who has already decided—execution is now in motion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。家賃の定率上げ方針です
lines.en: Yes. We'll also establish an emergency fax network for notifications.
lines.style: Professional clarity. Adds the secondary task without hesitation—demonstrating that he's already thinking two steps ahead. Steady pace throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不払い顧客への督促を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen collection efforts on accounts with unpaid invoices.
lines.style: Firmer edge to the voice. This is a harder directive than the others. Slight tension in the delivery—the business necessity behind it acknowledged without apology.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。緊急時のファクス連絡網も整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll also set up an emergency communication system via fax.
lines.style: Final confirmation, grounded and professional. Slight closing-down of breath—this is the last item. Voice settles into completion. Small nod implied in the delivery.
